verdict.rationale: Publishing a crawl policy is a fair question for a public government web service, so the axis applies. The only relevant probe shows the bizfile filing portal returns HTTP 200 for robots.txt but serves an Incapsula bot-management shell with no robots directives, so an agent cannot learn what it may read. No evidence shows a real robots.txt on www.sos.ca.gov, and the Franchise Tax Board probe concerns a different agency, so it is not counted.
